It is unclear whether he returned or never left. The prescription itself was never shown being issued on page 6, only listed in a label. The 'Meanwhile...' caption's text ('fills') runs right up to the box border. The 'The lab is notified.' caption box sits against the panel's top edge, and the LAB ORDER label overlaps the top of the monitor. The technician's tail tip in the middle panel ends against her hair bun. The caption breaks 'Dr. Ananya' / 'is notified' and 'The clinic' / 'is notified' show a visible leading-space indent on the second line. In the bottom-right upper panel the RESULTS READY label sits against the tablet's left edge and the doctor's left hand. Please check that it does not clip her fingers.
